command: PATH="$PWD/build/frontend-node-24.20.0-npm-11.19.0.TlvfpU/node/bin:$PATH" ./gradlew --no-daemon -x verifyFrontendToolchain test --tests 'decompengine.web.WebBoundedReadsHttpTest.upload request quota does not block unrelated HTTP status reads'
test: upload request quota does not block unrelated HTTP status reads
scope: Local deterministic HTTP qualification against the real SPA listener. Two streamed multipart requests reach staging and hold their upload reservations. A third request sends only headers and receives 503 UPLOAD_CAPACITY before multipart body bytes are sent. Four concurrent authenticated GET /w/api/v1/jobs/{id} reads complete during the held uploads; both held invalid fixtures are cleaned up, and a later valid upload succeeds.
limitations: This tests concurrent upload-request admission and status responsiveness; it does not inject a disk-full condition through the HTTP server.
The test does not measure physical-disk contention or deployed throughput.
It complements, but does not replace, the slow-dashboard listing HTTP qualification in PR #1951.
The broader upload/listing quota matrix and full #162 acceptance remain open.
